Service info

No interaction possible with expired/used deals

Show message: “You have not used any deals yet.”

Visual difference between active deals (U1/U4) and history deals (U5)

tasks.subject: Deals's (Phone view) U3
tasks.description:
Description
When a user is about to activate/redeem a deal, the system must show a confirmation screen (warning + approval). After confirmation, the salon is notified, and the deal is marked as redeemed.

UX Requirements

Confirmation step (before activation):

Show a warning message (e.g., “Are you sure you want to redeem this deal? This action cannot be undone.”)

Show an approval text (confirmation/OK message once redeemed)

Provide Confirm and Cancel buttons

Post-confirmation:

Deal is marked as redeemed for the user

If the company has set “1 per user” → the deal can no longer be used by this user

Salon receives a notification: “\[User Name] has redeemed a deal.”

States:

Active → Redeemed (user’s view changes to show it’s used)

User cannot access/reuse the deal again if rules block repeat usage

Design considerations:

Clear distinction between warning and success state

Simple dialog/modal style on mobile

Confirmation flow must feel final (no confusion about whether deal is used)

User actions:

Press Confirm → deal redeemed, salon notified, deal marked as used

Press Cancel → return to deal details without redeeming

Acceptance (UX view):

Warning + approval text shown before activation

Confirming redemption shows success/approval state

Redeemed deal is no longer available for repeat use (if rule = 1 per user)

Salon gets notification with user’s name and redeemed deal info

tasks.subject: Implement Claimed Status Logic in Deal Cards
tasks.description:
Update deal card behavior so that users see a clear claimed status (e.g., “Claimed”, “Claimed twice”) while still being able to interact with the deal until their max per user limit is reached or the deal expires.

🔧 Scope of Work
UI/UX

Add a status badge on the top‑right corner of each deal card showing claim count (e.g., “Claimed once”, “Claimed twice”).

Keep the button label as “Open Deal” (not “Claimed”) as long as:

Deal is not expired

User has not reached max per user limit

Logic

Track number of claims per user for each deal.

Display claim count dynamically on the badge.

Button state logic:

Open Deal → if user has claimed < max per user AND deal not expired

Claimed (disabled) → if user has claimed = max per user

Expired (disabled) → if deal expiration date passed
